pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/scan/route.ts:231 The word 'gate' is all over these files but names per-request admission (burst limit, sign-in, quota, credit), so no check here renders a verdict on a tree or item; a search of src/app and src/components for reference-transaction, pre-receive, max-warnings and no-verify found nothing, and no listed test reads source text.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/scan/route.ts:261 Refuses on a caller's quota window, which is billing admission and not a verdict on a change being gated.
src/app/api/scan/route.ts:411 It does name a remedy, but this is an HTTP method refusal to an API client and not a blocking check's message.
src/app/page.doors.test.ts:118 A control case in a behaviour test of the landing's degraded read; it does not prove a checker is alive.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/features/shared/registry/registryModel.ts:82 The migrate route stores moved: pr.committed.length while the state is still pr-open, and registrySteps tests migrateDone before migrateOpen, so a migration whose draft PR holds every file reads step 4 as done and the verdict line as n/n artifacts in the registry before anything has merged, filing in-progress work as satisfied.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/migrate/route.ts:69 Counts files committed to the PR branch as moved at state pr-open; the fixture's pr-open row uses moved: 0 (registry-view.fixture.ts:191), and registryModel.ts:82 and :135 then resolve the step to done. These setMigrationStep writes are also .catch(() => {}), so the record can silently miss the advance.
src/features/shared/registry/registryModel.ts:144 A missing fleet reading is announced as not measured and cannot satisfy the step; this is a stepper, so no refusal is involved.
src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:337 Never swept stays distinct from a clean result, by analogy to could-not-run versus pass.
src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/migrate/route.ts:34 Names the action, which step 1 of the same tab offers; the index route's not-mapped message states only the condition.
src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:344 A disclosed wire cap on a read model; it feeds no enforcement artifact.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/health/route.ts:49 The 'liveness' here is service uptime and the rest of the context is layout, SEO and brand copy, so no gate exists to judge; reference-transaction, pre-receive and branch-provenance appear nowhere in src, while broader words such as husky and max-warnings occur only in other areas (mainly the scanner's detectors and landing copy) and in none of this context's files.
